rounds.text: Siddhi Cotspin Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of just 0.51x [E2] and a modest P/E ratio of 7.19 [E1]. This valuation disconnect is particularly striking when contrasted with the company's robust long-term performance, characterized by a 28% compounded sales growth and 32% compounded profit growth over the last five years [E8, E11]. While the sector median profit growth sits at 20.0% [E46], the company has demonstrated its ability to capture market share, further supported by recent signals of sales growth on a quarter-over-quarter basis [E41]. Conceded: [E5, E13]. Despite the recent volatility in the trailing twelve months, the underlying business fundamentals remain supported by a 10.6% ROCE [E6]. The current market capitalization of ₹ 69.3 Cr does not appear to reflect the sustained multi-year growth trajectory established by the firm [E3, E12].
